summary: Ran backend + frontend regression for auth hardening and P&L workflows. Backend finance suite passed (11/11), but auth-hardening suite found lockout/CORS regressions. Frontend core order grouping/edit/refund/csv/payout flows were validated after a temporary cookie-clear workaround due a blocking 403 write bug.

critical.issue: Lockout is inconsistent across requests: 5 bad attempts did not reliably return 429 and successful login did not reliably clear counters. Root cause: identifier uses request.client.host + email; upstream IP varies (seen 10.6.131.139/10.6.131.140), splitting attempt counters.

Allowed preview origin OPTIONS preflight to /api/auth/login returns 400 'Disallowed CORS origin'. Browser-authenticated POST mutations with cookie (e.g., /api/stores) return 403 and block normal UI write flows.

ui_bugs.issue: With normal cookie-based login session, creating a store shows 'Kayıt başarısız' due backend 403. UI writes only worked after clearing cookie and relying on Bearer token.

integration_issues.issue: Observed mismatch with expected separation count in one run (CROSSMP grouped rows reported 1 instead of 2 under ALL context). Needs deterministic retest after auth/CORS blocker is fixed.

issues: Repeated console warnings from Recharts: width/height -1 on initial render.

action_items: Fix auth attempt keying to be stable per user/client context (do not rely on request.client.host behind ingress).
Fix CORS/preflight config for trusted preview origin and ensure cookie-based same-origin writes are not blocked.
Rerun UI end-to-end without cookie workaround once auth/CORS is fixed.
Retest multi-marketplace same-order separation deterministically after above blocker fix.
critical_code_review_comments: Using request.client.host in brute-force identifier is brittle in proxied deployments and breaks lockout/reset consistency.
Current middleware blocks legitimate browser cookie-authenticated mutation requests in preview environment.
Auth hardening acceptance criteria for lockout + allowed-origin preflight is not fully met.
seed_data_creation: Created test stores TEST_I3_USCA_154202, TEST_I3_CA_154202 plus test transactions/orders (TEST-1, TEST-2, CROSSMP, CSV-ORDER-1/2) and payout rows for workflow validation.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Key blocker: with standard cookie session, POST writes return 403. For coverage continuation, I used temporary cookie clearing in browser sessions to continue testing with Bearer token only. Core financial math/grouping for TEST-1/TEST-2 verified, refund recovery edit verified, CSV preview+commit verified once, payout effect verified (Bankada lowers amazon balance and increases received; Olusturuldu leaves both unchanged), CA-only store labels validated via store-switcher dropdown.
rca of the issue: Auth lockout inconsistency RCA: identifier includes request.client.host, but host changes per request through ingress, creating multiple login_attempt documents for same email and bypassing threshold/reset behavior. CORS/UI write RCA: trusted origin handling rejects allowed preflight and cookie-origin middleware returns 403 for legitimate browser mutation requests, causing 'Kayıt başarısız' in normal authenticated UI flow.
